desc: List fields: a field whose value is a flat list, encoded as US-separated items inside STX/ETX (DESIGN.md 'Nested Structures': arrays are simply US-separated values inside STX/ETX). Decode: every case's bytes are a bare record stream holding one record; each `record` entry that is a JSON array is read with the list accessor (Record#list) and must equal those logical items, every other entry is read as a scalar value. Encode: when `canonical` is true, building the record with the first field as a scalar and each later entry via list_field (array) or field (scalar) MUST produce exactly `bytes`, and `bytes` must be canonical. The first field is always a scalar.

cases.name: three-items
cases.desc: A list of three plain items between two scalar fields

cases.name: escaped-items
cases.desc: Item bytes < 0x20 (US, STX, RS) are DLE-escaped; an empty item is allowed

cases.name: empty-list
cases.desc: An empty scope is an empty list, not a list of one empty item

cases.name: two-empty-items
cases.desc: A lone US inside the scope yields two empty items

cases.name: two-lists
cases.desc: Adjacent list fields; ETX closes one before the next US

cases.name: binary-item
cases.desc: Unassigned NUL is escaped; 0xFF is raw

cases.name: nested-scope-in-item
cases.desc: A nested STX/ETX scope inside an item stays one item (decode only: an encoder would escape it)

cases.name: plain-field-as-list
cases.desc: Reading a non-scope field as a list yields its value as one item (decode only)

cases.name: missing-etx
cases.desc: A scope truncated before ETX still splits on US (decode only)
